title: Complete historical multiplication register with an unknown compositional decimal key
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED architecture record. The Treviso1478 primary facsimile contains44 complete multiplication equations in eight printed blocks. A shared unknown decimal digit code, two operator words and joint whole-block assignments could recover all numeral values together. Source availability and arithmetic are independently checked; manuscript compatibility and meaning are not implied. GDT902 selection is a separate explicit experimental decision.

design.complete_system: Eight blocks a=2..9; each lists b=a..9 followed by0, with five fields a fia b fa decimal(a*b).44rows,220fields,36numeric values and two operators. No inserted reversed products, ×1 cells or modern81-cell table. All44 cells independently collated twice. Scope is the complete register, not selected arithmetic coincidences.
design.mechanism: Ten shared nonempty prefix-free digit strings compose every decimal numeral. Two globally shared operator words are distinct from realized numerals. Eight source blocks map jointly to eight distinct complete permitted paragraphs; a global foreground lexicon preserves the entire source order after globally consistent background projection. No raw-first-word heading is assumed because the blocks have no lexical headings.
design.independent_constraint: Conditional on a complete projected embedding, distinct block sizes9..2 identify multiplier digits2..9; zero rows identify0; the10 result identifies1 by cancellation. This can constrain a whole reusable key but does not establish a unique target subset. Complete count capacity and all ordered operator-pair projections supply necessary falsifiers before any larger fit.
design.novelty_and_limits: GDT880 failed capacity for immediate same-head tail triples under provisional1..4 additive values. This is a different full-register decimal-composition law without inherited Voynich numeral assignments.1478 is later than ordinary Voynich dating; this is a same-mathematical-register hypothesis, not dependence on that print. No earlier exact triangular layout is established. Numeric cell serialization is a declared operational projection, not diplomatic spacing or cipher evidence. Full global-model failure closes only this source/channel/scope conjunction. No target data were consulted in producing this source idea.
